parsed.reason: Every tip is supported by the research notes: drowsy but awake, a consistent time and length, a dark quiet room, a lullaby or calm story before he gets cranky, falling asleep on his own, his own bed or crib, and back-sleeping with nothing soft in the crib. Nothing is invented about the child, and it hedges on age instead of assuming one. Including the safe-sleep line is the right care for a baby. The closing line about 'the search' and what 'I couldn't find' is meta and stiff, more assistant than friend, which takes some polish off an otherwise good, usable answer.
